sources.title: tartuNLP/Llama-3.1-EstLLM-8B-Instruct-1125 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model underwent continuous pre-training starting from meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B on approximately 35B tokens, which resulted in tartuNLP/Llama-3.1-EstLLM-8B-0525, then supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization were applied.
